current.label: v0.4.0 — Gateway v2 (Plan 2b: namespacing + merchant updates + same-token + event split)
changes: createInvoice/createInvoiceFor take merchantInvoiceId; contract derives globalId = keccak256(merchant, merchantInvoiceId)
Merchant struct gains payoutAddress (separate from msg.sender) and active flag; updatePayoutAddress, updatePayoutToken, deactivateMerchant added
pay() takes a no-swap branch when payIn == payoutToken (same-token direct payment)
InvoicePaid event split: 6 fields (id, payer, amountIn, grossReceived, merchantPayout, fee)
Invoice locks payoutToken at creation; later merchant updates do not reroute pending invoices

deprecated_v0.1.0.label: Plan 1 — Saddle StableSwap (replaced; left here for reference)
deprecated_v0.1.0.reason: StableSwap invariant assumes 1:1 peg between pooled tokens. With USDC/EURC at 1.0863 USD/EUR, the pool's implied rate stayed near 1:1 regardless of bootstrap balances, forcing the oracle to be set to parity to pass the deviation guard. Replaced in Plan 1.5 by OracleAMM (Chainlink-priced, no curve) which trades at the live oracle rate ± a 4 bps fee.
